headline: Executive order aimed at keeping athletes the order classifies as male out of women's and girls' sports.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets federal policy against people the order considers male competing in women's and girls' sports. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, enforcement steps, and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Transgender women and girls who play sports
who_it_affects.how: The order appears aimed at limiting their ability to compete on women's and girls' teams.

who_it_affects.group: Women and girls who play sports
who_it_affects.how: The order addresses who may compete alongside them in female sports categories.
They may be expected to follow the order's policy on who can join women's and girls' teams, though the details are not given here.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 5, 2025; specific effective dates were not provided.
